relu_construction.form: yhat(x) = a0 + sum_i a_i * ReLU(x - b_i)
relu_construction.fixed_knots_method: evenly spaced b_i, coefficients by least squares
relu_construction.learned_knots_method: a_i and b_i both by Adam, 4000 steps, lr 0.05

xor.note: a single linear map cannot do this; one hidden layer does it exactly

param_count._poly_note: complete = all monomials of total degree <= k, C(d+k,k); tensor = (k+1)^d, one degree-k factor per axis

nn_vs_cheb.note: deviation from the target, not the level

epoch_tradeoff.dgp: d=30, 13 of them signal, 17 irrelevant; one interaction and one tanh term; noise sd 0.25 (variance 0.0625) is the floor

regularization.note: same DGP, net and budget as epoch_tradeoff; median over 3 seeds

worked_nn_growth.model: quarterly RBC, Rouwenhorst 7 states, k in [0.5 k*, 1.5 k*] -- the same Proj object 5.B6 uses
worked_nn_growth.architecture: 3 hidden layers of 64, tanh; c = sigmoid(net)*cash
worked_nn_growth.feasibility: 0 < c < cash-on-hand by construction, not by penalty
worked_nn_growth.expectation: exact over the 7 Rouwenhorst states, not sampled

five_methods.model: quarterly RBC, Rouwenhorst 7 states, k in [0.5 k*, 1.5 k*]

nonconvex.note: the ICNN cannot fit it, by construction -- the guarantee from the other side

icnn.verdict: ACCURACY IS NOT ROBUST across seeds; the CONVEXITY VIOLATION is. Slides must claim only the second.

_meta.calibration: quarterly RBC (Quant_Macro Lab7), with Brock-Mirman delta=1 where a closed form is needed
_meta.rbc_model: imported from tools/figures/s05_generate.py (class Proj and euler_err_from_cpol), so 7.B1 and 5.B6 measure the same model with the same metric
_meta.optimizers: NOT recomputed here -- 7.A3 reuses keys 'cg_steps', 'optimizer_memory', 'sgd_trajectory', 'sgd_dimension' from tools/figures/s04_numbers.json

backprop_sigmoid.saturation_note: both factors yhat(1-yhat) and h(1-h) are at most 0.25; that product is where the vanishing gradient starts
